听说你有女朋友了？ (Tīngshuō nǐ yǒu nǚpéngyou le?) - I heard you have a girlfriend now?
我认识她吗？ (Wǒ rènshi tā ma?) - Do I know her?
就是我们班那个长着两个大眼睛，非常爱笑的女孩儿。 (Jiù shì wǒmen bān nàge zhǎngzhe liǎng ge dà yǎnjing, fēicháng ài xiào de nǚháir.) - She is the girl in our class with big eyes and a smiling face.
她不是有男朋友吗？ (Tā bú shì yǒu nánpéngyou ma?) - She's already got a boyfriend, hasn't she?
那个已经是她的前男友了。 (Nàge yǐjīng shì tā de qián nányǒu le.) - That's her ex now.
请问，这儿离新京宾馆远吗？ (Qǐngwèn, zhèr lí Xīnjīng Bīnguǎn yuǎn ma?) - Excuse me, is Xinjing Hotel far away from here?
不远，走路二十分钟就到。 (Bù yuǎn, zǒu lù èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.) - No, it's about a 20 minutes' walk.
你能告诉我怎么走吗？ (Nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zěnme zǒu ma?) - Could you tell me how to get there?
从这儿一直往前走，到了前面的路口再往右走。 (Cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dàole qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài wǎng yòu zǒu.) - Walk straight ahead from here and turn right at the first crossing.
门开着。 (Mén kāizhe.) - The door is open.
他们穿着红色的衣服。 (Tāmen chuānzhe hóngsè de yīfu.) - They are wearing red clothes.
（她）拿着铅笔。 ((Tā) názhe qiānbǐ.) - (She) is holding a pencil.
门没开着。 (Mén méi kāizhe.) - The door is not open.
他们没穿着红色的衣服。 (Tāmen méi chuānzhe hóngsè de yīfu.) - They are not wearing red clothes.
（她）没拿着铅笔。 ((Tā) méi názhe qiānbǐ.) - (She) is not holding a pencil.
门开着没有？ (Mén kāizhe méiyǒu?) - Is the door open?
他们穿着红色的衣服没有？ (Tāmen chuānzhe hóngsè de yīfu méiyǒu?) - Are they wearing red clothes?
她（手里）拿着铅笔没有？ (Tā (shǒu lǐ) názhe qiānbǐ méiyǒu?) - Is she holding a pencil (in her hand)?
不是说今天有雨吗？怎么没下？ (Búshì shuō jīntiān yǒu yǔ ma? Zěnme méi xià?) - Didn't they say it would rain today? Why hasn't it rained?
你不是北京人吗？怎么不会说北京话？ (Nǐ búshì Běijīng rén ma? Zěnme bú huì shuō Běijīng huà?) - Aren't you from Beijing? Why can't you speak the Beijing dialect?
（她是你的女朋友？）她不是有男朋友了吗？ ((Tā shì nǐ de nǚpéngyou?) Tā búshì yǒu nánpéngyou le ma?) - (Is she your girlfriend?) Doesn't she already have a boyfriend?
从这儿往前走，就是我们学校。 (Cóng zhèr wǎng qián zǒu, jiù shì wǒmen xuéxiào.) - Go forward from here and you will reach our school.
你看，往左走是医院，往右走是银行。 (Nǐ kàn, wǎng zuǒ zǒu shì yīyuàn, wǎng yòu zǒu shì yínháng.) - Look, go left and it is the hospital; go right and it is the bank.
从这儿一直往前走，到了前面的路口再往右走。 (Cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dàole qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài wǎng yòu zǒu.) - Walk straight ahead from here and turn right at the crossing ahead.
张先生去哪儿了？ (Zhāng xiānsheng qù nǎr le?) - Where did Mr. Zhang go?
杨笑笑是谁？ (Yáng Xiàoxiao shì shéi?) - Who is Yang Xiaoxiao?
他的女朋友是谁？ (Tā de nǚpéngyou shì shéi?) - Who is his girlfriend?
"前男友"是什么意思？ ("Qián nányǒu" shì shénme yìsi?) - What does "qián nányǒu" mean?
去新京宾馆怎么走？ (Qù Xīnjīng Bīnguǎn zěnme zǒu?) - How do you get to Xinjing Hotel?
让我们休息休息吧。 (Ràng wǒmen xiūxi xiūxi ba.) - Let us rest for a while.
快点儿下课吧。 (Kuàidiǎnr xià kè ba.) - Let's finish class quickly.
请坐吧。 (Qǐng zuò ba.) - Please sit down.
往前走 (wǎng qián zǒu) - walk forward
往后跑 (wǎng hòu pǎo) - run backward
往左看 (wǎng zuǒ kàn) - look to the left
往右走 (wǎng yòu zǒu) - walk to the right
有两个学生穿着白色的衣服。 (Yǒu liǎng ge xuésheng chuānzhe báisè de yīfu.) - There are two students wearing white clothes.
你看过那个电影没有？ (Nǐ kànguo nàge diànyǐng méiyǒu?) - Have you seen that movie?
没看过，听说很有意思。 (Méi kànguo, tīngshuō hěn yǒu yìsi.) - No. I was told it is fantastic.
那我们下个星期一起去看吧？ (Nà wǒmen xià ge xīngqī yìqǐ qù kàn ba?) - Why don't we see it together next week?
可以，但是我女朋友也想去。 (Kěyǐ, dànshì wǒ nǚpéngyou yě xiǎng qù.) - OK. But my girlfriend also wants to go.
听说你去过中国，还想去吗？ (Tīngshuō nǐ qùguo Zhōngguó, hái xiǎng qù ma?) - It's said you've been to China. Do you want to go there again?
我虽然去过好几次，但是还想再去玩儿玩儿。 (Wǒ suīrán qùguo hǎojǐ cì, dànshì hái xiǎng zài qù wánrwanr.) - Though I've been there several times, I still want to go for pleasure again.
那我们一起去吧。 (Nà wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba.) - Let's go together.
好啊，到时候我给你打电话。 (Hǎo a, dào shíhou wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.) - Great. I'll call you then.
明天天气怎么样？ (Míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) - How will the weather be tomorrow?
虽然是晴天，但是很冷。 (Suīrán shì qíngtiān, dànshì hěn lěng.) - It will be fine, but cold.
那还能去跑步吗？ (Nà hái néng qù pǎo bù ma?) - In that case, is it OK to go jogging?
可以，但是你自己去吧，我还有很多事情要做。 (Kěyǐ, dànshì nǐ zìjǐ qù ba, wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.) - I think so. But you have to go by yourself because I have a lot of work to do.
你在这个商店买过东西没有？ (Nǐ zài zhège shāngdiàn mǎiguo dōngxi méiyǒu?) - Have you ever bought anything in this store?
买过一次，这儿的东西还可以，就是不便宜。 (Mǎiguo yí cì, zhèr de dōngxi hái kěyǐ, jiùshi bù piányi.) - Yes, once. Things here are pretty good, not cheap though.
我喜欢这件衣服，但是觉得有点儿贵。 (Wǒ xǐhuan zhè jiàn yīfu, dànshì juéde yǒudiǎnr guì.) - I like this garment, but I think it's a little expensive.
两百块还可以，喜欢就买吧。 (Liǎngbǎi kuài hái kěyǐ, xǐhuan jiù mǎi ba.) - Two hundred yuan is not that expensive. If you like it, just buy it.
他们来过我家。 (Tāmen láiguo wǒ jiā.) - They have been to my home.
我看过那个电影。 (Wǒ kànguo nàge diànyǐng.) - I have seen that movie.
我去过中国。 (Wǒ qùguo Zhōngguó.) - I have been to China.
他们没（有）来过我家。 (Tāmen méi(yǒu) láiguo wǒ jiā.) - They have not been to my home.
我没（有）看过那个电影。 (Wǒ méi(yǒu) kànguo nàge diànyǐng.) - I have not seen that movie.
我没（有）去过中国。 (Wǒ méi(yǒu) qùguo Zhōngguó.) - I have not been to China.
他们来过你家没有？ (Tāmen láiguo nǐ jiā méiyǒu?) - Have they been to your home?
你看过那个电影没有？ (Nǐ kànguo nàge diànyǐng méiyǒu?) - Have you seen that movie?
你去过中国没有？ (Nǐ qùguo Zhōngguó méiyǒu?) - Have you been to China?
虽然外面很冷，但是房间里很热。 (Suīrán wàimiàn hěn lěng, dànshì fángjiān lǐ hěn rè.) - Although it is cold outside, it is hot in the room.
虽然汉字很难，但是我很喜欢写汉字。 (Suīrán Hànzì hěn nán, dànshì wǒ hěn xǐhuan xiě Hànzì.) - Although Chinese characters are difficult, I like writing them very much.
虽然是晴天，但是很冷。 (Suīrán shì qíngtiān, dànshì hěn lěng.) - Although it is a sunny day, it is very cold.
我们看过三次电影。 (Wǒmen kànguo sān cì diànyǐng.) - We have seen movies three times.
他们坐过一次飞机。 (Tāmen zuòguo yí cì fēijī.) - They have taken a plane once.
我（在这个商店）买过一次（东西）。 (Wǒ (zài zhège shāngdiàn) mǎiguo yí cì (dōngxi).) - I have bought (things) once (in this store).
我们去过三次北京。 (Wǒmen qùguo sān cì Běijīng.) - We have been to Beijing three times.
他们来过一次中国。 (Tāmen láiguo yí cì Zhōngguó.) - They have been to China once.
我（上星期）去过一次医院。 (Wǒ (shàng xīngqī) qùguo yí cì yīyuàn.) - I went to the hospital once (last week).
我们去过北京三次。 (Wǒmen qùguo Běijīng sān cì.) - We have been to Beijing three times.
他们来过中国一次。 (Tāmen láiguo Zhōngguó yí cì.) - They have been to China once.
我（上星期）去过医院一次。 (Wǒ (shàng xīngqī) qùguo yīyuàn yí cì.) - I went to the hospital once (last week).
我们找过他三次。 (Wǒmen zhǎoguo tā sān cì.) - We have looked for him three times.
他们看过我一次。 (Tāmen kànguo wǒ yí cì.) - They have seen me once.
老师叫过我两次。 (Lǎoshī jiàoguo wǒ liǎng cì.) - The teacher has called me twice.
他们看过那个电影吗？ (Tāmen kànguo nàge diànyǐng ma?) - Have they seen that movie?
他们想几个人去看电影？ (Tāmen xiǎng jǐ ge rén qù kàn diànyǐng?) - How many people do they want to go to the movie?
他们想来中国做什么？ (Tāmen xiǎng lái Zhōngguó zuò shénme?) - What do they want to do when they come to China?
为什么她明天不能去跑步？ (Wèi shénme tā míngtiān bù néng qù pǎo bù?) - Why can't she go jogging tomorrow?
女的觉得这个商店的东西怎么样？ (Nǚde juéde zhège shāngdiàn de dōngxi zěnmeyàng?) - What does the woman think of the things in this store?
今天天气真好啊！ (Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn hǎo a!) - The weather is really nice today!
这个汉字真难写啊！ (Zhège Hànzì zhēn nán xiě a!) - This Chinese character is really hard to write!
这件衣服太漂亮了！ (Zhè jiàn yīfu tài piàoliang le!) - This garment is so beautiful!
虽然这件衣服很漂亮，但是太贵了，我没钱买。 (Suīrán zhè jiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang, dànshì tài guì le, wǒ méi qián mǎi.) - Although this garment is very beautiful, it is too expensive and I have no money to buy it.
我在北京买过一件很漂亮的衣服。 (Wǒ zài Běijīng mǎiguo yí jiàn hěn piàoliang de yīfu.) - I bought a very beautiful garment in Beijing.
今天是12月20日，新年就要到了。 (Jīntiān shì shí'èr yuè èrshí rì, xīnnián jiù yào dào le.) - Today is December 20th. The New Year is coming.
新年你准备做什么？ (Xīnnián nǐ zhǔnbèi zuò shénme?) - What plans do you have for the New Year?
我想去北京旅游，北京很不错，我去过一次。 (Wǒ xiǎng qù Běijīng lǚyóu, Běijīng hěn búcuò, wǒ qùguo yí cì.) - I want to take a trip to Beijing. Beijing is a nice place. I've been there once.
你买票了吗？ (Nǐ mǎi piào le ma?) - Have you bought the ticket?
还没有呢，明天就去火车站买票。 (Hái méiyǒu ne, míngtiān jiù qù huǒchēzhàn mǎi piào.) - Not yet. I'll go to the railway station to buy it tomorrow.
时间过得真快，新的一年快要到了！ (Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, xīn de yì nián kuàiyào dào le!) - How time flies! The New Year is approaching!
是啊，谢谢大家这一年对我的帮助！ (Shì a, xièxie dàjiā zhè yì nián duì wǒ de bāngzhù!) - Yes. Thank you all for your help during the past year.
希望我们的公司明年更好！ (Xīwàng wǒmen de gōngsī míngnián gèng hǎo!) - I hope our company will become even better in the next year.
你妹妹怎么还没来？ (Nǐ mèimei zěnme hái méi lái?) - Why hasn't your younger sister arrived yet?
都八点四十了！ (Dōu bā diǎn sìshí le!) - It's already eight forty!
我们再等她几分钟吧。 (Wǒmen zài děng tā jǐ fēnzhōng ba.) - Let's wait for her a few more minutes.
都等她半个小时了！ (Dōu děng tā bàn ge xiǎoshí le!) - We've already waited for her for half an hour!
她来了，我听见她说话了。 (Tā lái le, wǒ tīngjiàn tā shuō huà le.) - She is here. I heard her voice.
天阴了，我要回去了。 (Tiān yīn le, wǒ yào huíqu le.) - It's overcast. I have to go home.
好的。快要下雨了，你路上慢点儿。 (Hǎo de. Kuàiyào xià yǔ le, nǐ lùshang màndiǎnr.) - OK. It's going to rain. Be careful on your way.
没关系，我坐公共汽车。 (Méi guānxi, wǒ zuò gōnggòng qìchē.) - Don't worry. I'll take a bus.
好的。再见。 (Hǎo de. Zàijiàn.) - Good. Bye.
火车快要来了。 (Huǒchē kuàiyào lái le.) - The train is about to arrive.
要下雨了。 (Yào xià yǔ le.) - It is going to rain.
新的一年快要到了。 (Xīn de yì nián kuàiyào dào le.) - The New Year is coming.
下个月我们就要回国了。 (Xià ge yuè wǒmen jiù yào huí guó le.) - We will return to our country next month.
明天姐姐就要走了。 (Míngtiān jiějie jiù yào zǒu le.) - My elder sister will leave tomorrow.
下个星期我们就要考试了。 (Xià ge xīngqī wǒmen jiù yào kǎoshì le.) - We will have an exam next week.
都8点了，快点儿起床吧。 (Dōu bā diǎn le, kuàidiǎnr qǐchuáng ba.) - It's already 8 o'clock. Get up quickly.
你都十岁了，可以自己洗衣服了。 (Nǐ dōu shí suì le, kěyǐ zìjǐ xǐ yīfu le.) - You are already ten years old and can wash your clothes by yourself.
都等她半个小时了。 (Dōu děng tā bàn ge xiǎoshí le.) - We've already waited for her for half an hour.
新年的时候他准备做什么？ (Xīnnián de shíhou tā zhǔnbèi zuò shénme?) - What does he plan to do at New Year?
明天他有什么事要做？ (Míngtiān tā yǒu shénme shì yào zuò?) - What does he have to do tomorrow?
他们两个人在等谁呢？ (Tāmen liǎng ge rén zài děng shéi ne?) - Who are the two of them waiting for?
他们等的人来了没有？ (Tāmen děng de rén láile méiyǒu?) - Has the person they are waiting for come?
外面的天气怎么样？ (Wàimiàn de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?) - What is the weather like outside?
这本书是你的吧？ (Zhè běn shū shì nǐ de ba?) - This book is yours, isn't it? (falling intonation)
这本书是你的吗？ (Zhè běn shū shì nǐ de ma?) - Is this book yours? (rising intonation)
明天是星期二吧？ (Míngtiān shì xīngqī èr ba?) - Tomorrow is Tuesday, isn't it? (falling intonation)
明天是星期二吗？ (Míngtiān shì xīngqī èr ma?) - Is tomorrow Tuesday? (rising intonation)
你买票了吧？ (Nǐ mǎi piào le ba?) - You've bought the ticket, haven't you? (falling intonation)
你买票了吗？ (Nǐ mǎi piào le ma?) - Have you bought the ticket? (rising intonation)
